messages.text: Hi, I forgot my password and can't get into Quillstack. My account email is priya.n@northfield-studio.example. How do I reset it?

expected.rationale: Self-serve password reset is fully covered by KB-101 and nothing has been tried yet.

messages.text: Our company card expired last month and now there's a banner saying the payment failed. I'm the workspace owner. How do I put a new card on file so we don't lose access?

expected.rationale: The owner can replace the card and retry the payment by following KB-201.

messages.text: We don't use the Business features anymore. How can I move our workspace down to the Team plan, and when would the change take effect?

expected.rationale: KB-204 explains how to downgrade and when the change takes effect.

ticket.subject: Need a full copy of our workspace

messages.text: Before our annual audit I need a complete copy of all our documents and files. Is there a way to export the whole workspace in one go?

expected.rationale: Workspace export is self-serve and covered by KB-401.

ticket.subject: New hire never got the invite

messages.text: I invited our new designer (lena.k@harborline.example) to the workspace two days ago, but she says the invitation never arrived. Can you help?

expected.rationale: KB-301 covers missing invitations and none of its steps have been tried.

ticket.subject: Changes not showing up for teammates

messages.text: Since yesterday, edits I make in the desktop app on my MacBook (macOS 15) aren't showing up for my teammates. The app just says "Syncing…" forever.

expected.rationale: KB-104 applies, the operating system is given, and no sync incident is active on 2026-10-28.

messages.text: Our webhook wh_2k9d7x1p stopped receiving events yesterday afternoon. The dashboard shows the deliveries as failed. What should we check?

expected.rationale: KB-501 applies, the webhook ID is given, and the webhook incident INC-2191 was resolved a week earlier, so it is not relevant.

messages.text: My desktop app has been stuck on "Syncing…" all morning and my edits don't reach the rest of the team. What can I do?

expected.rationale: KB-104 says to confirm the operating system first, and the ticket does not mention it.

messages.text: We were charged for another month even though we meant to cancel. Could we get that charge refunded?

expected.rationale: Refunds need the invoice number (KB-202), which also shows the charge date.

messages.text: One of our webhooks has been failing since this morning and our integration is falling behind. How do we fix it?

expected.rationale: KB-501 says to ask for the webhook ID before troubleshooting.

messages.text: The Quillstack desktop app closes immediately every time I open it. It was working fine last week.

expected.rationale: KB-107 says crash fixes depend on the operating system and app version, and neither is given.

messages.text: Nothing works since the update. Please fix this asap.

expected.rationale: The ticket does not say which part of the product is affected, so no article can be chosen yet.

messages.text: We're on the Team plan. Uploading a 180 MB video fails every time in the browser. Is there a size limit, and can we upload this file at all?

expected.rationale: KB-105 says paid plans allow 250 MB and KB-106 says 100 MB. A 180 MB file falls between the two, so the answer depends on which article is right.

messages.text: I'm an admin in our workspace and I need to remove someone who left the company, but I can't find a way to do it. Are admins allowed to remove members?

expected.rationale: KB-302 says only owners can remove members and KB-303 says admins can. The customer is an admin, so the disagreement decides the answer.

messages.text: We upgraded to the annual Business plan 20 days ago, but it turns out we don't need it. Can we get a refund? The invoice is INV-204518.

expected.rationale: KB-202 allows refunds within 14 days and KB-203 within 30 days. A charge 20 days ago is inside one window and outside the other.

messages.text: I accidentally upgraded our workspace 3 days ago and was charged for it. Can I get a refund? The invoice number is INV-337120.

expected.rationale: KB-202 (14 days) and KB-203 (30 days) disagree, but a charge 3 days ago is refundable under both, so the disagreement does not change the answer.

messages.text: Quillstack on my Windows 11 laptop hasn't synced for two days. I already updated to the latest version, signed out and back in, reset the local cache and even reinstalled the app. Still nothing syncs.

expected.rationale: All four KB-104 steps have been tried and sync still fails.

messages.text: Files I edit on my Mac (macOS 14) aren't syncing to the web app. I've updated the app and signed out and back in, but it didn't help.

expected.rationale: Steps 1 and 2 failed, but steps 3 and 4 of KB-104 have not been tried yet.

messages.text: I asked for a password reset an hour ago and never got the email. My account is yuki.t@lanternworks.example.

Thanks, Yuki! Please check your spam folder and any company mail filters for a message from no-reply@quillstack.example, then request a new link. Only the newest link works, and it expires after 30 minutes.
I checked spam and requested two more links. Still nothing. I also tried a private window in case it was my browser.

expected.rationale: Every KB-101 step was suggested or tried and no email arrives. KB-101 says the address may be suppressed, which only staff can clear.

ticket.subject: Lost my phone, can't log in

messages.text: I lost my phone over the weekend and Quillstack keeps asking for my two-step verification code. I don't have my backup codes and I'm not signed in on any other device. My account email is daniel.o@fieldnote.example.

expected.rationale: Neither KB-102 step is possible (no backup codes, no trusted device), so Account Security must verify identity.

messages.text: Webhook wh_8f3k2m9q has been failing since Tuesday. I checked that our endpoint returns a 200 in under a second, rotated and updated the signing secret, and re-enabled the webhook twice. Deliveries still fail.

expected.rationale: All three KB-501 steps have been tried and deliveries still fail.

messages.text: I got an email about a sign-in from a country I've never been to, and some of my files were shared with people I don't know. I've already changed my password. What else should I do?

expected.rationale: KB-103 says suspected compromise is always escalated to Trust & Safety.

messages.text: Please delete my account and all the personal data you hold about me, as required under data protection law. My email is elif.d@quietmail.example.

expected.rationale: KB-402 says deletion and personal-data requests always go to the Privacy team.

messages.text: Our IT team wants to roll Quillstack out to 300 people, but only if we can enforce SAML single sign-on through our identity provider. Is that supported, and how do we set it up?

expected.rationale: No article covers single sign-on, so the agent must not guess.

messages.text: Our latest invoice INV-551032 shows an old VAT number for our company. Our finance team needs a corrected invoice re-issued for that charge. Can you do that?

expected.rationale: Billing articles mention invoices, but none covers correcting or re-issuing one.

messages.text: Since this morning my changes in the desktop app take ages to show up for my colleagues. I'm on Windows 11. Is something wrong on your side?

expected.rationale: Incident INC-2207 (delayed desktop sync) is active when the ticket arrives. The reply should point to the incident, not send troubleshooting steps.
